title: Transformation and Transition Management
lead: The management of complex organisational and IT transformation programmes — governing the journey from current to target operating model.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Transformation management encompasses the governance, change management, communication and workstream coordination needed to deliver large-scale operating model change. Transition management specifically focuses on the operational handover phase — ensuring continuity of service while new capabilities are stood up.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Every ITOM engagement culminates in a transformation and transition phase. The target operating model must be implemented in a controlled, sequenced manner that manages risk, maintains service continuity and delivers sustainable change. Transformation management provides the governance wrapper for this journey.

items.desc: Sequenced plan for moving from current to target state across all operating model dimensions.
Managing the human side of transformation — communications, engagement, resistance.
Operational handover plan ensuring continuity of service during change.
Orchestrating parallel workstreams (people, process, technology, governance).
Monitoring realisation of transformation benefits against the business case.
